excludedReason: yield = production / area; using either would leak the target.
target: yield (production / area, as recorded in the dataset)
unitNote: The dataset does not state a unit and the scale differs by crop.

scaleBreak.note: In the source data, recorded yield values are on a much larger scale from 2015 onward (for 48 of 52 major crops the typical value is more than 20 times higher than in 2010-2014). The dataset gives no unit, so none is shown, and predictions for years before and from 2015 are not comparable with each other.

dataNote: In the source data, recorded yield values are on a much larger scale from 2015 onward (for 48 of 52 major crops the typical value is more than 20 times higher than in 2010-2014). The dataset gives no unit, so none is shown, and predictions for years before and from 2015 are not comparable with each other.
metricsNote: Computed by this training script on this dataset. Yield values span several orders of magnitude (e.g. coconut) and change scale around 2015 (see scaleBreak), so RMSE and R2 are dominated by large-valued rows and by the year effect; they should not be read as agronomic accuracy.
